title: Profile Registry — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Profile Registry solution should meet the objective: Store and retrieve profile records with a struct and mapping. Explain data visibility and what data remains publicly observable on-chain. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
